hypotheses.statement: PLAN D4 decision-stage bound: the NAME acceptance association (G_dec, 2024-26) is not identified by the audit (tipping point inside the audit 95% CI of the net-flip DiD).
hypotheses.estimate: net-flip DiD +1.48 pp [-0.63, +3.59] (pseudo-flip; plain Wald [-0.54, +3.50], bootstrap [-0.53, +3.44]); D*_dec 2.92 pp; one-sided p(DiD < D*) 0.127; observed G_dec 1.050 [1.027, 1.073]; G_dec at the audit point estimate 1.025; share of the G_dec excess attributable to editing at the point estimate 50% (audit CI -21% to 124%); audit-implied G_dec [0.988, 1.061]; n = 803/508 pairs (v1-present 256/155)
hypotheses.notes: NAME G_dec identified in no spec under any CI type (14 specs x 3 CI types, T4_2_identification_by_spec.csv).

hypotheses.statement: Gate (PLAN section 4, Holm per section 0): at least one title feature's acceptance association (G_dec != 1, 2024-26) survives the audit: auditable (arXiv-measurable, >= 10 v1-present titles per arm), editing-corrected 95% CI excludes 1, Holm-adjusted one-sided identification p < 0.025.
hypotheses.estimate: 0 of 26 title features pass (18 auditable); passing: none. Smallest identification p: O_union_arxiv p = 0.0160 (Holm 0.289), DiD +1.09 vs D* -1.14 pp; compound p = 0.0409 (Holm 0.695), DiD +0.74 vs D* +3.24 pp; sentence_case p = 0.0439 (Holm 0.702), DiD +0.77 vs D* -0.94 pp. Uncorrected interim rule: 2 pass ['O_union_arxiv', 'compound']
hypotheses.notes: Uncorrected identification of G_dec (tipping point beyond one 95% CI type), by feature: compound: pseudo-flip CI in 5 specs (abstract_matched, incl_2022, ipw_find, primary, union_route_v7sub); Wald/bootstrap only in year_std; word_name: pseudo-flip CI in 0 specs (-); Wald/bootstrap only in incl_2022, ipw_find, primary, timing_std, union_route_v7sub, year_std; O_union_arxiv: pseudo-flip CI in 10 specs (abstract_matched, incl_2022, ipw_find, ipw_find_pop, original_only, primary, timing_std, union_route_v7sub, v1_before_deadline, year_std); Wald/bootstrap only in post_2024_26; using: pseudo-flip CI in 0 specs (-); Wald/bootstrap only in timing_std, year_std; via: pseudo-flip CI in 4 specs (ipw_find_pop, new_records_2024_26, new_records_only, post_2024_26); Wald/bootstrap only in union_route_v7sub; sentence_case: pseudo-flip CI in 0 specs (-); Wald/bootstrap only in abstract_matched (of 14 specs; T4_2_identified_anywhere.csv). Freeze path (T4_2_freeze_path.csv): 254 lines: uncorrected [O_union_arxiv], Holm []; 600 lines: uncorrected [compound,sentence_case,O_union_arxiv], Holm []; 1000 lines: uncorrected [compound,sentence_case,O_union_arxiv], Holm []; 1261 lines: uncorrected [compound,sentence_case,O_union_arxiv], Holm []; 2004 lines: uncorrected [compound,O_union_arxiv], Holm []

hypotheses.statement: V7: rare lexical title features ('using', R24, R26, LLM slot words, title typography) are unauditable (fewer than 10 v1-present titles in an arm, or not carried by arXiv metadata).
hypotheses.estimate: using: v1-present 19/25, auditable=True; R24: v1-present 31/17, auditable=True; R26: v1-present 28/8, auditable=False; slot_llm: v1-present 23/5, auditable=False; title_typo: v1-present 0/0 (channel), auditable=False
hypotheses.notes: Auditability is a function of audit size: auditable features by enlargement lines used: 254: 10; 600: 12; 1000: 15; 1261: 17; 2004: 18. Original 331-pair audit: 'using' 4/5 v1-present (the PLAN example reproduces).

hypotheses.statement: Differential findability: accepted papers are found on arXiv more often than rejected papers; reweighting usable pairs by 1/P(usable | year, decision, title length, NAME) leaves the NAME bound unchanged (not identified).
hypotheses.estimate: original + enlargement 2023-26: found 86.5% vs 53.1% (n 1300/1300); odds ratio(accepted) 5.68 [4.68, 6.89]; usable pair OR(accepted) 2.55 [2.17, 2.99]; IPW x population NAME DiD 1.45 pp [-0.81, 3.71], identified=False
hypotheses.notes: Generated: found OR(NAME) 1.00 [0.81, 1.22], p = 0.982; found OR(log title words) 0.75 [0.56, 0.99]; usable-pair OR(NAME) 1.12 [0.94, 1.34], p = 0.209; acc x NAME interaction for found 1.19 [0.78, 1.83]; pre-decision v1 given found OR(accepted) 0.91 [0.73, 1.13].

hypotheses.statement: Camera-ready retitling: accepted papers' stored titles differ from the pre-decision arXiv v1 more often than rejected papers' (descriptive; no pre-registered threshold).
hypotheses.notes: Rejected papers retitle too; the in-review stratum (v1 close to the submitted version) is the cleanest camera-ready comparison. Share of pairs with v1 in review: acc 54.3%, rej 50.0% (Fisher p = 0.140).

hypotheses.statement: Route validation (findability): the accepted-rejected findability gap is not specific to title search: a title-free route (first-author surname + distinctive abstract words) gives the same gap. Both routes accept a hit by similarity between the stored and the latest arXiv abstract, so they are not independent of post-rejection rewriting.
hypotheses.notes: Near-miss bound (same-surname, date-plausible candidate with abstract Jaccard >= 0.10 below the acceptance tiers, among papers neither route found): accepted 1, rejected 14; counting them as found, the union gap moves from 0.333 to 0.247. Title-clause-only admissions among primary pairs: acc 1.6%, rej 9.1%.

hypotheses.statement: Route validation (title stability): the title route does not select on title stability; retitling among route-B pairs matches route-A pairs, and adding papers only route B finds leaves the flip DiDs unchanged.
hypotheses.estimate: retitled v1 vs stored: route A 0.244 (n=160), route B 0.265 (n=155), difference 2.1 pp; B-only usable pairs 6 (4 retitled); NAME DiD with B-only pairs (300-paper subsample) 1.28 pp; abstract-matched pairs only 1.59 pp [-0.65, 3.82]
hypotheses.notes: Verdict rule (set after the pilot design, descriptive): supported if route-level retitling rates differ by < 5 pp and route-B-only pairs are not retitled > 20 pp more often; partially supported if only the first holds; not testable with fewer than 5 B-only pairs.

hypotheses.statement: Gate for D4-H4a: NAME neutrality (pooled 2024-26 G_total inside [0.90, 1.11]) survives camera-ready uncertainty (editing-corrected 90% CI combining universe bootstrap and audit).
hypotheses.estimate: G_total observed 1.021 90% CI [1.001, 1.041]; audit-implied [0.948, 1.033]; corrected 90% CI [0.949, 1.031]; G at the audit point estimate 0.991. G_dec corrected 90% CI [0.988, 1.059]
hypotheses.notes: Other audit specs: post_2024_26: [0.926, 1.019] passes=True; original_only: [0.885, 1.069] passes=False; new_records_only: [0.950, 1.038] passes=True; v1_in_review: [0.930, 1.018] passes=True. Literal section 4 rule (D*_total 1.04 pp vs audit upper CI 3.59 pp): not met.
